rules: Source links and answer-key transcription do not count as full question-content import.
Do not publish question content until source, rights, and answer verification are complete.
Recalculate percentages whenever the audited scope changes.
Partial question records are tracked separately and do not count as a complete subject question set.
Overall target includes all historical junior-high Basic Competency Tests (ROC 90-102) and CAP exams (ROC 103-115).
Do not calculate a complete historical question-bank percentage from the earlier 14-item 2025-2026 scope.
Previously imported 2026 math records remain unverified draft records until question numbers, wording, figures, and official answers are reconciled.
Registering a secondary dataset or source links does not count as question text import, official verification, or rights clearance.
A full paper can be marked 100% transcribed only when all expected question records are present; this is separate from official verification and publishable status.
目前批次與進度文件以 CAP 民國 103–115 年為活躍範圍；若使用者再次明確擴大至舊制基測，需先同步更新 scope 與分母，不能混算。
Every question record must include a source citation URL and a question-specific locator; missing citations fail structural validation.
nextBatchStrategy: multi-subject parallel queue; prioritize text stems/options/reading passages; retain figure placeholders and asset paths for image-dependent questions
